subtypes.name: descriptive observation
subtypes.definition: The passage merely lists or describes anatomical features without claiming any essence.

subtypes.name: comparative analysis
subtypes.definition: The passage compares species or parts but does not generalize to a defining essence.

subtypes.name: no generalization
subtypes.definition: The passage fails to generalize or define a kind, lacking a claim about what animals fundamentally are.

subtypes.name: explanatory mechanism
subtypes.definition: The passage explains a mechanism or process but does not define the essence of the animal or part.

subtypes.name: divine causation without purpose
subtypes.definition: The passage describes divine creation or causation but does not attribute a specific purpose to the animals.

subtypes.name: epistemological argument from design
subtypes.definition: Animal features are cited as evidence for a designer, but no claim is made about the animals’ purpose or nature.

subtypes.name: animals as occasions for human contemplation
subtypes.definition: Animals are used as examples for moral or spiritual reflection, not as beings defined by purpose or essence.

subtypes.name: lack of explicit animal reference
subtypes.definition: The passage does not name any animal or part and therefore does not provide an ontological characterization.

subtypes.name: functional organ description
subtypes.definition: Describes an animal part by its function or use.

subtypes.name: functional/ecological class definition
subtypes.definition: Classifies animals by their ecological role or function.

subtypes.name: behavioral role description
subtypes.definition: Describes animal behavior or role in a functional context.

subtypes.name: functionally defined class term
subtypes.definition: Uses a class term that defines animals by function.

subtypes.name: functional description
subtypes.definition: The passage describes an animal part or whole by its function or use rather than its intrinsic essence.

subtypes.name: behavioral classification
subtypes.definition: The passage categorizes animals based on instinctive habits or natural behaviors.

subtypes.name: purpose‑driven explanation
subtypes.definition: The passage explains an animal part by what it is adapted to do or its intended purpose.

subtypes.name: structural‑functional emphasis
subtypes.definition: The passage notes structural differences but centers on the functional operation of the part.
